notes.title: April 12th, 0.53v - Troops, Saving stats, Achievements, New UI, Research...
notes.content:
So much has been added. Regular updates have been added to playtest however not to the main page. 

Here is the long list of updates that has happened on the playtest since the last update on the main slime wars page.

[list]
[*] Added all enemy slimes to the game
[*] Added early access banner
[*] Redesigned Queue UI (Smaller, removed number of units queued)
[*] Redesigned Main Menu
[*] Redesigned Win Screen
[*] Added a shop where you can buy early access banner and support the team in the game dev journey
[*] Added Achievements
[*] Fixed Data Saving
[*] Added research Tab (Not functional just yet)
[*] Added canons and upgrades to canons
[*] Added Exp
[*] Redesigned Lumber camp
[*] Changed enemy spawn rates
[/list]

notes.title: Beta is now public to everyone! Please fill out the survey after.
notes.content:
Hello Everyone! Game Dev is going really well.
 
I have a very early version of the game built so you can test it and give feedback. After a few iterations I will release it in early access. 

Survey: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfl196svsw-k34y6C_BrH6utg9iwaLVIbmzAb9RPNI9-BVT7g/viewform?usp=dialog

notes.title: Beta Test is coming, Signup to participate!
notes.content: Hello Everyone! We are striving to get a free demo/alpha build out for end of next month. We are flying through development right now. Signup for the Beta Test to see the progress and give feedback to help us out!

notes.title: Major Progress on Slime Wars
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

I've made significant progress on Slime Wars over the past week! Here’s what’s new:


[olist]
[*] New Animations
[*] Pause & Play functionality
[*] Fresh Units & Building Icons
[*] Achievements
[*] And plenty of quality-of-life improvements
[/olist]

I'm hoping to launch Slime Wars this summer, and I’m currently putting together three dev logs to highlight these updates and the progress I've made so far. Be sure to stay tuned and check out my YouTube channel to get the latest updates on all Phantom Studios games!

https://www.youtube.com/@jonahbron2425

Thanks for the support!
